messages:
alex.k: Hey team — PR #1289 (streaming-cache-fix) is green locally and has approvals, but cross-region CI stalled on the e2e matrix. Can someone re-run the failing job? we want to land before the deploy freeze starts tomorrow.

maria.t: I can kick it off in a sec. which job is failing?

alex.k: The job is `e2e:region-routing-us-eu`. ci-bot showed it as flaky and then timed out. snippet:```
--- FAIL: TestRegionRouting (0.00s)
    routes_test.go:142: expected 3 routes, got 0
--- FAIL
exit status 1
```

ci-bot: Re-run requested by maria.t — job queued (build 4521). ETA ~6m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam.p: quick FYI — there's a scheduled deploy freeze starting 2026-03-20 00:00 UTC for infra maintenance. Anything we can't merge before then needs explicit approval from release leads.

alex.k: Thanks — that's the constraint. If the rerun passes, can we aim for a tiny rebase window today? I don't want this to sit into the freeze.

maria.t: rerun just finished — job passed on node 3/4 but flaky on node 4. logs show a transient 503 from the mock routing service. I'll re-run node 4 only.

ci-bot: Node 4 re-run requested (build 4523) — running.

maria.t: Also heads-up: main had a tiny networking change earlier; if 4523 fails we might need a quick rebase to pick up the fix. That would push past the freeze unless we grab the late rebase window.

sam.p: We have a 30-min rebase window today at 18:30 UTC for urgent fixes. If you can finish the rebase and prove CI within that slot we can land before freeze. Otherwise we'll schedule a post-freeze canary.

alex.k: OK I'll prep the rebase branch now and ping when ready. If 4523 is green, can someone from release please approve immediate merge? @sam.p or @maria.t? :eyes:

maria.t: If 4523 is green I'll approve and trigger merge. If it fails, wait for alex.k to push the rebase.

ci-bot: Build 4523 finished — all e2e nodes passed. :white_check_mark:

maria.t: Approved and queued merge through merge-bot. Please confirm no last-minute DB migrations.

alex.k: No DB migrations, only cache key handling. Merging now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: merge-bot: PR #1289 merged to main by maria.t (commit a7f4c2d). Deploy scheduled to canary cluster.

sam.p: Nice. I'll monitor canary and hold off wider rollout until morning to avoid freeze overlap. ping if anything looks off.

alex.k: I'll watch logs for the next 30m and report back. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

maria.t: great teamwork — saved the rebase window. :party_parrot:
